name: Instagram
description: Instagram login — email/username + password. Web login form.

login_steps.selector: input[name='username'], input[autocomplete='username'], input[aria-label='Phone number, username, or email']

extraction_targets.name: feed_data
extraction_targets.js_extract: (() => { const posts = document.querySelectorAll('article div[role="presentation"]'); const items = []; posts.forEach((p, i) => { if (i < 20) items.push(p.innerText.substring(0, 500)); }); return { url: window.location.href, post_count: items.length, posts: items, body_text: document.body ? document.body.innerText.substring(0, 5000) : '' }; })()
extraction_targets.description: Extract Instagram feed posts after login
